facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4111 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4111 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4111 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 31 March 2010 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
